name: 06420 · Salem, CT
findings: ZIP 06420 (Salem) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06420 (Salem) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06420 (Salem) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
